blind_spots_patched: The 25-million-share ($1.8 billion fair value) AWS customer warrant recorded as contra-revenue, plus the -$607 million Nonreportable segment EBT loss and $2.62 billion Modular Inc. acquisition.

Audited 42% top-2 customer concentration, 42% China (incl. Hong Kong) geographic revenue exposure ($18,079M), and $18.6 billion in unconditional foundry/OSAT purchase obligations ($13.8B due in FY2027).

Post-cutoff $4.0B senior notes issuance lifting pro forma debt to $17.10B, $4.1B unrecognized RSU backlog offsetting $7.82B buybacks (ending shares -0.2%), $5.7B CAMT tax release mechanics, and Nov 2026 Rule 10b5-1 insider sales.
assumptions_changed: WEAKENED: Liquidity dipped slightly after $6,806 million in buybacks, $2,868 million in dividends, and the Alphawave deal; debt stood at $15,112 million in notes and net share count is shrinking ~2.5%–3% annually after SBC offset.
WEAKENED: Instead of chasing mega-mergers, CEO Cristiano Amon favored smaller IP bolt-ons like Nuvia and the $2.3 billion Alphawave purchase to build non-handset growth legs without over-leveraging.

CONFIRMED: Qualcomm neutralized its core Arm/Nuvia legal threat and locked in multi-year QTL renewals, while Apple's C1/C1X/C2 internal modem transition caused Handsets to fall 13.4% YoY in FY2026 (-26% in Q4).
CONFIRMED: Automotive hit $6,004M (+51.7% YoY; $1,990M in Q4 FY26), QCT EBT margin compressed 330 bps to 27.1%, and Q1 FY2027 guidance targets $10.4B–$11.2B revenue and 20%–22% QCT EBT margin.
